args.title: Fix first-run calculation for weekly scheduled exports created on run day
args.body:
File: src/export/scheduler.ts

Fix `nextRunAt` for weekly cadences so that a schedule created on the target day of the week (e.g. Monday) schedules its first run for that same day rather than skipping a full week.
